description: Search the Signal Lab catalog of free and free-to-start data sources, tools and models across finance, macro, energy, agriculture, transport, research, weather, news, OSINT and cyber threat. Filter by domain, category, type, badge, license, task or date (list_filters shows values). Returns up to 25 rows, most relevant first. Use get_entry, export_catalog or get_source_urls for more.

auth.description: What sign-up the provider asks for, as the catalog records it, such as none or free registration

badge.description: Access type: Free, Open Source, Freemium or Unofficial

category.description: The catalog's category, for example Market Data or Macro

domain.description: Data domain: Financial, Global Macro, Energy, Agriculture & Food, Money Flows, Transport & Shipping, Research & Grey Literature, Weather, News & RSS, OSINT or Cyber Threat

license.description: The catalog's license value, for example Provider terms or MIT

query.description: Words or known alias concepts; ranked by relevance and an entry needs only one to match. Alias concepts match whole terms. A plain word matches a whole word or word start in the catalog text, or more weakly a mid-word substring. A word with punctuation (like ADS-B) also matches joined (ADSB) and spaced (ads b) forms.

task.description: One task tag, for example macro or market-data

type.description: Kind of entry, for example Dataset or Tool

verified.description: true: only entries counted as Verified resources in llms.txt; false: only the others (Signal Lab originals: recipes and starter kits; and entries marked Needs review)

verified_since.description: Only entries whose lastVerified date is on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: search_catalog
title: Search the catalog
